item.title: “Double standards must be avoided”- R Ashwin reveals why he refuses to criticize MCG pitch for fourth Ashes 2025-26 Test
item.description: Ex-India spinner R Ashwin has refused to criticize the pitch for the recent fourth Test of the Ashes 2025-26 series between England and Australia that was played in Melbourne Cricket Ground (MCG). The Test match lasted only two days as Australia was dismissed for 152 and 132, and England made 110 and then successfully chased down a 175-run target with four wickets in hand. item.title: “He can’t match Virat Kohli’s intensity”- Monty Panesar says Shubman Gill can’t be India’s all-format captain
item.description: Former England cricketer Monty Panesar has spoken about the pressure on India’s ODI and Test captain Shubman Gill and why he can’t be an all-format captain for the side. Panesar also spoke about how ‘complacent’ Gill cannot match the concentration and intensity of Virat Kohli. BCCI decided to name Shubman Gill the Indian Test captain after Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli retired from Test cricket. item.title: “There is a status quo…”: Mohsin Naqvi again asks BCCI to send captain to collect Asia Cup from him
item.description: The Men’s Asia Cup 2025 concluded with a massive controversy in September as Team India refused to accept their winners' trophy and medallions from ACC and PCB chief Mohsin Naqvi, who is also Pakistan’s Interior Minister and posted anti-India sentiments on social media throughout the tournament. Furious with India’s stand, Naqvi took the silverware and medals in his custody. item.title: “I want to make it very clear…,” Rajeev Shukla reacts to reports of BCCI considering replacing Gautam Gambhir as Test coach
item.description: BCCI vice-president Rajeev Shukla has refuted reports claiming that the board is considering appointing a new head coach in place of Gautam Gambhir in the Test format. With Gambhir at the helm, India have won seven, lost 10 and drew two of their 19 Tests so far, which includes a couple of clean sweeps against New Zealand (0-3) and South Africa (0-2) at home. item.title: Ashes 2025-26: “When match ended in Ahmedabad…,” Aakash Chopra calls out English media’s 'hypocrisy' over MCG pitch
item.description: The Melbourne pitch dished out for the Boxing Day Ashes Test has come under severe scrutiny after the game was over inside two days, with England defeating Australia by four wickets. The surface was prepared with 10 millimetres of grass on the wicket, making it heavily favourable for the pace bowlers. item.title: ‘Got confident after playing in front of 50,000 in Chinnaswamy’- Jacob Bethell says IPL stint calmed his nerves on Ashes debut
item.description: England batter Jacob Bethell credited his stint in the Indian Premier League (IPL) with the Royal Challengers Bengaluru (RCB) for helping him calm his nerves and handle pressure when he played his first Ashes 2025-26 Test for England. Bethell was included in England XI in place of Ollie Pope and struck a composed 40 as England chased down 175 to win the fourth Ashes Test that was played in Melbourne. item.description: Abhishek Sharma, an Indian cricketer, was summoned on stage by global music sensation AP Dhillon during a live concert, sparking a viral moment off the field. Dhillon recognized Abhishek in the crowd, called him up, and greeted him with a hearty hug. item.title: “It didn’t seem like a natural exit”: Uthappa makes bold comment on Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli’s Test retirements
item.description: Rohit Sharma and Virat Kohli retired from Test cricket within a gap of five days in May this year, leaving a big void in the Indian team ahead of the five-match series in England. item.title: WATCH: “He will make a brilliant comeback,” Harbhajan Singh warns against writing Shubman Gill off in T20Is
item.description: Shubman Gill, who was recalled to the T20I set-up as vice-captain ahead of the Asia Cup, has been left out of India’s squad for the ICC Men’s T20 World Cup 2026, to be played in India and Sri Lanka from February 7 to March 8. The move came after Gill struggled to make an impact with the bat since his return to the T20I fold, scoring 291 runs in 15 matches at an average of 24.25 and a strike-rate of 137.26.
